svg.title: IBM MaaS360 in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for MaaS360: one console for mobile devices and laptops; threats identified and answered in near real time, with native protection on the device; a free 30-day trial. Each figure is IBM's, from its MaaS360 product and pricing pages. IBM states no test conditions for them.
